definition: Musical pieces created spontaneously without being planned or written beforehand.
book: The Fall of the House of Usher
author: Edgar Allan Poe
quote: We painted and read together; or I listened, as if in a dream, to the wild improvisations of his speaking guitar.
example_sentence: The jazz trio's improvisations kept the crowd guessing.
